checks: Native content projection binds the frozen T1..T5 parry damage ratios as exact fractions (2/1, 23/10, 13/5, 29/10, 16/5) against independent frozen-row oracles from CT_ForkBuff GE_Fork_yaodao_Skill_Damage, asserts the native description text and key buff_fork_yaodao_effect, and rejects a group mismatch (character:1019, group TWO vs weapon group THREE) and a flipped bIsPercent unit hint (yaodao_projection_binds_five_refinement_tiers, yaodao_projection_rejects_group_mismatch_and_changed_units).

Config validation: a proc on a foreign weapon is rejected ('weapon:fork_yaodao'), a zero ratio is rejected ('Crimson Hexblade requires a positive parry damage ratio'), a zero-denominator ratio is rejected via ExactFraction::from_ratio before the positivity check, and a foreign proc kind is rejected ('equipment validator received the wrong proc kind'); a legal T1 config validates (yaodao_validate_config_rejects_mismatches, yaodao_validate_config_rejects_zero_denominator_ratio).

Runtime: a packet carrying the content-owned ntesim.trigger.parry_attack tag is rejected with 'Crimson Hexblade Parry requires an unsupported separate Incantation ATK packet' instead of staging a bonus, so the bonus is never executed in the content simulation; a packet without the tag and no staged proc leaves ratio_add at 0 (yaodao_reached_parry_rejects_a_substituted_coefficient, yaodao_no_proc_no_bonus_even_with_tag).

Independent hand-derived oracles: T1 2.0 = 2/1, T2 2.3 = 23/10, T3 2.6 = 13/5, T4 2.9 = 29/10, T5 3.2 = 16/5, bound from the frozen curve rows through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent=true retained as a display hint without unit conversion.

Focused run: 6/6 yaodao tests pass (5 pre-existing + yaodao_validate_config_rejects_zero_denominator_ratio). rustfmt not run on the repo (only tools/cargo.py fmt --check is allowed; write-mode formatting is a known tree-wiping hazard).
Web scenario web/tests/combat/yaodao.mjs is registered in web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs for CI; WASM is not built in this Linux env, so the web test was not executed here.
combat_scope: Projection of the frozen T1..T5 parry damage ratios into a wearer GearProcConfig::YaodaoParry. The bonus is not executed in the content simulation: a reached ntesim.trigger.parry_attack tag is rejected (Q1-V3 return condition), and substituting the frozen coefficient into the triggering packet's base term is forbidden, so no staged damage bonus reaches the damage zones.

GE_Fork_yaodao_Skill_Damage.unit: absolute ATK coefficient (bIsPercent display hint, no unit conversion)

independent_oracles: T1 parry damage ratio: frozen curve value 2.0 = 2/1. (yaodao_projection_binds_five_refinement_tiers)
T2 parry damage ratio: frozen curve value 2.3 = 23/10.
T3 parry damage ratio: frozen curve value 2.6 = 13/5.
T4 parry damage ratio: frozen curve value 2.9 = 29/10.
T5 parry damage ratio: frozen curve value 3.2 = 16/5.

These five hand-derived fractions are read from the frozen CT_ForkBuff rows through the refinement DataList, not from the implementation; the existing projection test asserts each staged ratio against them. A multiplicative misreading (e.g. 23/10 as '23%') is excluded by the unit check on bIsPercent.
known_gaps: Q1-V3: Parry admission is not modeled by the engine. The trigger is the content-owned ntesim.trigger.parry_attack semantic tag, an explicit scenario-level declaration, never a silent zero and never an invented native trigger. Return condition: bind native Parry delivery to a separately attributed Incantation ATK packet before any runtime execution.

runtime_execution_validated is false, honestly: mod.rs::damage_bonus returns Err when the parry tag is reached ('Crimson Hexblade Parry requires an unsupported separate Incantation ATK packet'), so the frozen ratio is projected but never staged or consumed by the damage zones.

No native trigger for Parry Attack exists in the engine (no input action role, damage source category, or packet tag marks them natively), so the parry tag can only ever be a caller-supplied declaration in scenarios.
Web tests were authored and registered but not executed here: no WASM build exists in this Linux environment; they are written for CI.
name: Crimson Hexblade

passive_description.localized: Deals additional Incantation DMG equal to <lv>{0}</> of ATK when the wearer triggers a Parry Attack.
passive_description.source: 装备者触发承轨反击时额外附带一次<lv>{0}</>攻击力的咒属性异能伤害。

tested_hypotheses: The 2.0/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2 values are absolute ATK coefficients bound from CT_ForkBuff through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent=true retained as a display hint without unit conversion.

Parry Attacks have no native engine trigger; the content-owned ntesim.trigger.parry_attack semantic tag is the explicit scenario-level declaration, and reaching it at runtime is an honest rejection, not an execution (Q1-V3 return condition).

The frozen coefficient must not be substituted into the triggering packet's base term; the adapter returns Err rather than staging a bonus, so the damage zones are never reached with a yaodao contribution.
Config validation rejects a zero ratio, a zero-denominator ratio, a foreign weapon, and a foreign proc kind; a legal config validates.
Item group must equal wearer group (CHARACTER_GROUP_TYPE_THREE); cross-group projection is rejected.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
